Design & Engineering Standard

2. Mobile UX Guiding Principles

PRINCIPLE 01

Preserve the Editorial Soul

Retain Silkscreen Cream (#F6F1E7), Ivory Paper (#FBF8F3), Siamese Emerald (#13382E), Siam Terracotta (#A8442A), Antique Brass (#9E7B3B), DM Serif Display & JetBrains Mono.

PRINCIPLE 02

Thumb-Zone Architecture

Primary Step switching, Quick Pocket utility, and modal Done CTAs live in the bottom 35% of the phone screen (dvh + safe-area insets).

PRINCIPLE 03

Daylight Contrast in the Field

No sub-11px critical copy or low-contrast captions outdoors in Bangkok traffic or Gatwick terminal queues (>=12px labels, high-contrast black-on-white Thai cards).

PRINCIPLE 04

At-a-Glance Before Deep Editing

Optimize for reading the next step, showing a driver Thai script, converting Baht, or tapping Done; tuck rich editing forms behind action sheets.

PRINCIPLE 05

Zero Desktop Regression

Use Tailwind responsive prefixes (md: / lg:) cleanly so desktop users retain the broad two-column luxury dossier and full financial ledger table.

Architecture & Component Specifications

3. Detailed Improvement Plan (Phases 1–5)

Phase 1 · Mobile Navigation, Chrome & Typography Foundations (P0)

1.1 Bottom Tab Bar + Slim Scrubber

Keep top StickyStepNav 6-tab grid at md+. On <768px, replace with a 5-slot thumb bar (Plan, Vault, center ฿ Pocket trigger, Pack, More sheet containing Prep/Guide/Budget) + single thin sticky horizontal date scrubber with scroll fade masks.

1.2 Single-Row Top Editorial Bar

Prevent multi-line wrapping on 375–430px by showing compact ← Space, segmented S | N pill, compact Sync status dot + icon, and moving Change Log count into More or top drawer.

1.3 Collapsible Mobile Masthead

Merge H1 + concise route summary + compact 82d 18h countdown chip into one card with Trip Overview ▾ accordion (<md), cutting above-fold hero height by >55%.

1.4–1.6 Safe Toast, Font Bundling & Floor

Move copy/sync toasts to top-center pill (top-3, env(safe-area-inset-top)); replace @import external Google/CDNFonts strings with bundled next/font/google + offline fallback stack in P1 alongside Offline PWA support; purge all 172 sub-11px classes and set text-base on inputs.

Phase 2 · Modals, Bottom Sheets & Touch Gestures (P1)

2.1 Slide-Over Drawers → 92dvh Bottom Sheets

Convert WardrobeDrawer and ChangeLogDrawer below sm into rounded top-corner sheets (max-h-[92dvh], drag bar handle, sticky bottom Done/Apply action bar) while keeping sm:max-w-* slide-overs on desktop.

2.2 QuickPocketDesk Bottom Sheet & Bugfixes

Eliminate floating w-80 bottom-5 left-5 box; open 85dvh sheet from Bottom Nav’s center button with Baht presets, non-overflowing wrapped PNR/Ref copy chips, fixed ≈ symbol, and 1-tap 1155/1669 dial triggers.

2.3 Touch Lightbox & Dialog Ergonomics

Make PolaroidCollageTile inspect/expand chips always visible on coarse pointers; add swipe-left/right navigation inside GarmentLightboxModal, closedby="any" / drag-down dismiss, and stop unconditional autoFocus on mobile form modals so soft keyboards do not cover headers.

Phase 3 · On-the-Ground Travel Companion Mode (P1)

3.1 Auto-Focus Today / Active Day

Default to Today’s date card when Feb 4–14, 2027 (fixed to Asia/Bangkok + Europe/London instead of UTC toISOString()) or show Next Up countdown pre-trip, placing primary Maps/Taxi/Check-in buttons up top.

3.2 Emergency & Concierge Speed-Dial

Ensure one-tap tel:1155 (Tourist Police), tel:1669 (EMS), tel:+6623058333 (British Embassy), plus Shangri-La & Pavilions reception numbers are accessible directly from Pocket/More without scrolling Step V.

3.3 Full-Screen Taxi Driver Card

Upgrade DriverCardModal on mobile to full-bleed 100dvh pure-white card with navigator.wakeLock.request("screen") badge, large lang="th" typography, full-width single-line Copy/Maps/Call buttons, and bottom thumb Done.

Phase 4 · Step-by-Step Touch & Information Density Polish (P2)

4.1–4.2 Itinerary Cards & Collapsed Suggestions

Clean vertical card stacks with 44×44 checkbox hitboxes, single ⋯ overflow action menu per activity row, and collapsible 4 Suggestions ▾ pill per day so scheduled plans stay visible above the fold.

4.3 Financial Matrix → Stacked Cards

Transform FINANCIAL_MATRIX <table> into stacked mobile cards (md:table preserved for desktop) paired with sticky bottom surplus strip (+£72.65) and instant + Add Expense CTA.

4.4 Wardrobe Upload & Collage Layout

Keep existing Packing Ledger <label> row tap, category accordions, and Unpacked Only filter; upgrade CreateLookModal with real device photo upload (<input type="file" accept="image/*" capture="environment"> / client compression) and decouple Polaroid header badges from tile photos.

Phase 5 · Performance, Offline Resilience & Viewport Meta (P1 / P3)

5.1 Viewport Export & Debounced Sync

Add explicit Next viewport export (viewportFit: "cover" for notch/home-indicator safe areas) and debounce PUT cloud sync writes (500–800ms + flush on visibilitychange) in useThailandTripState.ts.

5.2–5.3 Offline Cache, Splitting & Reduced Motion

Bundle offline read fallback (service worker / indexed JSON shell so Taxi cards & PNRs work with dead cellular in transit), next/dynamic code-split modals/non-active steps, keep -72px/-8px compact scroll hysteresis, and respect prefers-reduced-motion.

QA Matrix & Decisions Needed Before Coding

5. Testing Plan & Open Decisions

DECISION 01

Active-Trip Focus Mode

Should Step I auto-collapse other days into a compact switcher on mobile (Feb 4–14, 2027 in ICT) with a single "Show Full Spread" toggle?

DECISION 02

Tab Reduction Strategy

Is moving Steps III, V, and VI into a structured More tab sheet (or keeping Step V SOS quick-pinned) preferred over a 6-item horizontal scrollable strip?

DECISION 03

Wardrobe Photo Storage

For CreateLookModal mobile uploads: compress client-side as base64 data URLs inside existing JSON state (zero infra) or add lightweight Blob storage?

DECISION 04

Offline Taxi Mode Scope

Confirm whether read-only offline availability for itinerary, PNRs, SOS, and Thai Driver Cards satisfies field reliability without offline edit conflict queues.

Verification & Automated Regression Targets

  • Viewport checks: 375×667 (SE), 390×844 (iPhone), 430×932 (Pro Max) + 1440×900 desktop parity — zero horizontal overflow (scrollWidth <= clientWidth) across all 6 Steps.
  • Existing Jest suites: Keep thailand-2027.test.tsx, StickyStepNav.test.tsx, and PolaroidOutfitCard.test.tsx green (39 tests passing at baseline) plus new responsive/bottom-nav assertions.
  • Accessibility & touch gates: 100% >=16px inputs on mobile, >=44×44px critical targets, native <dialog> focus trapping, and Wake Lock fallback verification.
